app_info.subtitle: Work tools and memory
app_info.description: Karelin MCP lets approved users work with private Microsoft 365, Azure Key Vault, Obsidian, Neo4j, TickTick, QMD search, and Hindsight memory workflows through ChatGPT. It supports searching and reading workspace data, creating drafts, calendar events, notes, tasks, and memories, and managing selected private records through authenticated MCP tools.

test_cases.description: Find and summarize a recent email conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my email for the latest message about the rollout plan and summarize the most relevant thread.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching message details and a concise summary without changing mailbox state.

test_cases.description: Create a calendar event from explicit scheduling details.
test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a 30 minute planning meeting tomorrow at 10 AM with the team and make it an online meeting.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the event and reports the subject, time, and meeting status for review.

test_cases.description: Search a private note vault and append a short update.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my project planning note in Obsidian and append a short status update about today's decision.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds the relevant note, appends the requested update, and confirms the note path.

test_cases.description: Select a graph database and run a read-only Cypher query.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the available Neo4j servers, select the right one, show me the schema, then run a read-only query for the top project nodes.
test_cases.expected_output: Reports the selected server, schema highlights, and query records without writing graph data.

test_cases.description: Use indexed context to create a task and retain a decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search the QMD index for the deployment checklist, create a TickTick task for the next action, and remember the decision in Hindsight.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses indexed context to create a task and stores a concise private memory of the decision.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for travel booking requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me the cheapest flight from San Francisco to New York next Friday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not book travel or purchase tickets.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated image analysis.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Identify the objects in this vacation photo and make it look cinematic.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because image understanding and editing are outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for financial trading instructions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy 100 shares of NVDA in my brokerage account right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not connect to brokerage or trading systems.
